design_description: A dark and dramatic concept built around the theme of duality and inner conflict. The black base is split visually by contrasting angelic and demonic illustrations emerging from each side of the torso, divided by a sharp red vertical line running through the center. Gold typography and subtle red-and-gold trims elevate the design with a premium, almost ceremonial feel, while the distressed textures and shadowed artwork create a raw, emotional atmosphere. Overall, the jersey feels symbolic and cinematic — a battle between light and darkness translated into football culture.
